pointer-only-handlers-no-keyboard-path.why: F54 pointer-only control must be reachable and executable by keyboard.

emulated-control-focusable-but-not-activ.why: F42 focusable fake control fails keyboard activation; tab then press Enter.

drag-drop-endpoint-vs-path-exception-and.why: Endpoint-dependent drag function must be operable by keyboard somewhere on page.

hover-pointer-only-revealed-essential-co.why: Hover-revealed function/essential info must be keyboard-accessible or available elsewhere.

focus-removed-on-receipt.why: F55 strips focus on receipt; focus must rest so control is operable.

keystroke-timing-dependence.why: Activation depends on keystroke timing; isolated by no-keystroke-timing test.
